ping.social.business@1:
Object type ping.social.business@1 (Business).
A business: name, description, category, website, contact details, hours, and social links. The root object a generated site is built around.
Fields:
  - title (string, required): The business name.
  - description (string, required): What the business does, in its own words.
  - category (string, optional): Trade or industry category.
  - website (url, optional): Public website URL.
  - phone (string, optional): Public business phone.
  - email (string, optional): Public business email.
  - hours (string, optional): Opening hours as published.
  - socials (string[], optional): Public social profile URLs.
Relationships:
  - provides -> ping.social.service@1, ping.social.product@1: Services or products the business offers.
  - publishes -> ping.social.post@1, ping.social.article@1: Posts or articles the business published.
  - located_at -> ping.social.location@1: Where the business operates.
  - employs -> ping.social.person@1: People behind the business.
ping.social.service@1:
Object type ping.social.service@1 (Service).
A service the business offers: name, description, and optional price or duration hints. Rendered as cards in Services sections.
Fields:
  - title (string, required): The service name.
  - description (string, required): What the service includes.
  - price_hint (string, optional): Published price guidance, never a quote.
  - duration (string, optional): Typical job duration as published.
Relationships:
  - provided_by -> ping.social.business@1: The business offering this service.
ping.social.post@1:
Object type ping.social.post@1 (Post).
A post or article: title, body text, publish date, and tags. Rendered in feeds and recent-objects sections. Replies reference posts.
Fields:
  - title (string, required): The post title.
  - text (string, optional): The post body text.
  - date (string, optional): Publish date as published.
  - url (url, optional): Canonical link to the full post.
  - tags (string[], optional): Topic tags.
Relationships:
  - published_by -> ping.social.business@1: The business that published this post.
  - replies_to -> ping.social.post@1: The post this replies to.
